task: Fill gaps in trim/baseboard with wood filler
steps: Apply paintable caulk (for wall-to-trim gaps) or wood filler (for wood-to-wood gaps).
Smooth with a finger or putty knife.
Let cure, then lightly sand wood filler flush.

materials.name: DAP Plastic Wood 16 oz. paintable wood filler
3M Pro Grade Precision 80/120/220 grit sandpaper kit
